title: A registered test module whose file is not in the commit builds nowhere but on the machine that has it
body: Found 2026-09-12: d4d7aec2b carried a `suite.rs` registration for a file only one node had, and HEAD could not build its test target until 5746e02e. A pre-commit arm that refuses a `suite.rs` naming a `#[path]` the index does not carry is small. hv's to rule; cc's if ruled. Carried in `intent/wip.md` until 2026-09-13.
